datasets.name: GIFT: Global Inventory of Floras and Traits
variables_present: plant trait list incl. Dispersal_syndrome_1 (9,602 records) and Dispersal_syndrome_2 (6,518)
variables_missing: endemism per island not verified: query=checklists without parameters returned an empty list
datasets.scope: Vascular plants only; 109 traits listed in traits_meta
datasets.evidence: API 200: traits_meta returns 109 rows; Dispersal_syndrome_1 count 9,602 (categorical). Plants only, so it cannot give the cross-taxon comparison (seabirds, shells).

summary: Datasets cover only parts: no single open dataset gives island-by-island endemism for several taxonomic groups together with an independent dispersal measure. GIFT has plant dispersal syndromes and floras, AVONET has bird traits, WoRMS/OBIS have marine checklists, but endemic flags per island for birds, shells and insects were not found; three keyword searches returned zero hits.
next_step: Compile island checklists with endemic status for 2-3 archipelagos (e.g. birds, land snails, marine molluscs, plants) from regional checklists; join GIFT dispersal syndromes and AVONET traits.
obstacles_confirmed: Independent dispersal traits available for birds and plants only
Residence time/island age needed as covariate
Arrival 'in a body' is rarely recorded
